checks: Reviewed exact command/owner/provider identities, ordinal comparison, UTC instants, copied reference collections and fail-fast missing-input checks at the committed SHA.
Both key namespaces are explicit: an owner retry cannot change its provider key and another owner cannot inherit that key within the same provider binding.
No network execution or implicit business outcome is introduced; safe metadata minimization remains the owner responsibility.
Provider capability stays in the existing Platform assembly and reuses TechnicalCommandEnvelope and IdempotencyScope; no Common/Utils layer, generic adapter subsystem or reservation store is added.
Typed internal provider evidence conforms to Documents 23/32; immutable exact binding context preserves provenance without becoming domain truth.
The shared decomposition map is coordination metadata; only the provider source/tests/guide are owned behavior paths.
No provider SDK type, Product-facing API contract, SDK package or new external endpoint is introduced.
Idempotency/key conflict checks are pure and do not hide retries or reinterpret transport errors as payment failure; DifferentIdentity is not permission for another effect.
Provider-specific key limits and request fingerprint semantics remain in the selected owning adapter contract; no universal Stripe policy is imposed.
Canonical Drive Documents 23/32 and accepted ADR-0014 were fetched and reviewed. Document 13 requires current implementation-time primary-source checks.
Stripe idempotency/error handling, .NET 10 OpenAPI and published OAS 3.1 documentation were checked on 2026-10-05 and recorded in the scope source registry.
No new external dependency/version/provider selection was made; provider-specific limits and external reconciliation are not encoded as generic Tunner rules.

76 executed architecture cases pass, including 40 provider cases covering key collisions/switching, trace/fingerprint conflicts, scopes, copied collections, missing inputs, UTC and cross-binding evidence rejection.
Existing authorization/idempotency/version, OpenAPI, policies, realtime and storage regression cases pass; exact tested/validated SHA matches committed owned Git blobs.
Earlier candidate results and corrected precommit syntax failure are distinguished from final readiness; no test discovery or historical evidence substitutes for executed tests.

limitations: Codex engineering role reviews; no independent human, Product or production acceptance is asserted.
